text:
sam: Nightly e2e perf gate failed on longseq workload — p95 up ~40% and throughput down ~18%. Jenkins job: https://ci.redwood/blue/organizations/jenkins/nightly-e2e/detail/nightly-e2e/342
ci-bot: [AUTO] job nightly-e2e #342 failed. summary: longseq p95 210ms -> 295ms, throughput 520rps -> 430rps. artifacts: /artifacts/nightly/342/metrics.json
maria: Yikes. Any obvious deploys around the window?
deploy-bot: deploy redwood-runtime@v2.13.1 rolled at 2026-03-11T02:10Z to canary, promoted at 02:27Z (sha: b3f9c7d).
lee: I merged PR #1884 (kvcache batching tweak) yesterday morning, but it was only server-side scheduler change. diff: https://gh/redwood/runtime/pull/1884
sam: Could be that. Can someone rerun the nightly e2e with the old scheduler flag to reproduce? If reproduced, we should bisect between b3f9c7d and the previous deploy.
maria: I can kick off a focused rerun for longseq now w/ warmup and 5 repeats. Command I use:```./ci/run_e2e.sh --job nightly-e2e --case longseq --repeats 5 --warmup 600 --env SCHEDULER=legacy```
ci-bot: rerun started (job id: rerun-1918234701). I'll post metrics when done. (react: :hourglass:)
sam: Great — if rerun matches regression, request bisect on the runtime kernel/queue area. @lee can you grab the suspect commits from yesterday?
lee: copying list: b3f9c7d, 9a12f4e (quant opt), 4d2a8b0 (sched fix), 6e7c1aa (docs). My hunch is 4d2a8b0 -> 4d2a8b0 touched batching timers.
maria: rerun finished. quick summary: p95 median 298ms across repeats, throughput avg 435rps. Numbers match failing run. Uploading full metrics: /artifacts/rerun-1918234701/metrics.json
sam: Ok confirmed repro. Can someone kick bisect? Steps: 1) create a bisect job spanning sha before b3f9c7d and b3f9c7d inclusive 2) run with same config as rerun 3) stop on first bad commit. Example bisect command:```./tools/bisect/run_bisect.sh --good sha=af22e1 --bad sha=b3f9c7d --test "nightly-e2e --case longseq --repeats 3 --warmup 300 --env SCHEDULER=legacy"```
maria: Starting bisect now, tagging @eng-oncall so we can escalate if it pins to infra.
eng-oncall: oncall acked — I'll watch resource usage and be ready to rollback canary if bisect blames runtime. Please post bisect results in this thread. (react: :eyes:)
sam: Thanks all. If bisect points to lee's scheduler change, we'll open a revert PR and run a canary rollback. I'll update the incident tracker.
lee: noted, standing by to dig into 4d2a8b0 if bisect yields it.
maria: logging the rerun + bisect artifacts in the ticket: https://issues.redwood/INF-672
sam: Closing loop later today with postmortem if we need revert. (react: :thumbsup:)
